```yaml
name: PR Docs Preview

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, closed]

jobs:
  preview:
    if: github.event.action != 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install mkdocs mike

      - name: Build MkDocs
        run: mkdocs build

      - name: Deploy preview to docs.sleap.ai
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          mike deploy --push --branch=pr/${{ github.event.number }} pr/${{ github.event.number }}

      - name: Get changed docs URLs
        id: changed_urls
        run: |
          python scripts/get_changed_docs_urls.py > urls.txt
          echo "urls=$(cat urls.txt | tr '\n' ' ')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post or update preview comment
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const previewUrl = `https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${{ github.event.number }}/`;
            const changedUrls = '${{ steps.changed_urls.outputs.urls }}'.trim().split(' ');
            const commentBody = `## PR Preview\n\nPreview URL: ${previewUrl}\n\n${changedUrls.length > 0 ? 'Changed pages:' : ''}\n${changedUrls.map(url => `- ${url}`).join('\n')}`;
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
            });
            const existing = comments.find(c => c.body.includes('## PR Preview'));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: existing.id,
                body: commentBody,
              });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                body: commentBody,
              });
            }

  cleanup:
    if: github.event.action == 'closed'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install mike
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mike

      - name: Delete preview from docs.sleap.ai
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          mike delete --push pr/${{ github.event.number }}
```
